This is an incredibly difficult and painful situation, and it's important to recognize that using suicide threats to control your behavior is a form of emotional manipulation, even if your partner is genuinely suffering. You are not responsible for their choices, and you cannot sacrifice your own wellbeing to keep them safe.

When they threaten suicide, take it seriously by contacting a crisis line or emergency services rather than absorbing the responsibility yourself. You can say something like, "I care about you, and because I take this seriously, I'm going to call someone who can help keep you safe." This protects both of you — they get professional support, and you are not held hostage by the threat.

You deserve boundaries, space, and care. Consider reaching out to a therapist for your own support, and don't hesitate to lean on trusted friends or family. You cannot be your partner's only lifeline, and trying to be will only deplete you both. Please take care of yourself — your needs matter too.
